source.title: Pricing (Claude Developer Platform documentation), section 'Model pricing'
notes: Prices are the page's 'Model pricing' table: base input, 5m cache writes, 1h cache writes, cache hits and refreshes, output tokens.
Cache hits on Claude Fable 5.1 are 0.025x and on Claude Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 0.05x the base input price (page footnotes 1 and 2); all other models 0.1x.
Claude Sonnet 5's $2/$10 is the standard price (page footnote 3).
All requests in the data used standard speed, standard service tier and global or unreported inference geography, so no fast-mode, priority or data-residency multiplier applies.
Current list prices are applied to every request regardless of its date; they weight token kinds and models, they are not the operator's bill (the operator is on a subscription).
